title: The Sleepy Princess
note: 英文人工 SRT 与中文翻译逐条对齐；纯音效/水印行已剔除。

lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig, this is my little brother George,
lines.zh: 我是佩奇，这是我的弟弟乔治，

lines.en: this is Mummy Pig, and this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 这是猪妈妈，这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: Peppa Pig
lines.zh: 小猪佩奇

lines.en: The Sleepy Princess
lines.zh: 瞌睡公主

lines.en: It is night time. Peppa and George are going to bed.
lines.zh: 现在是晚上。佩奇和乔治要去睡觉了。

lines.en: Good night Peppa and George.
lines.zh: 晚安佩奇和乔治。

lines.en: Mummy? Daddy?
lines.zh: 妈妈？爸爸？

lines.en: Yes Peppa?
lines.zh: 是佩奇吗？

lines.en: I'm not sleepy. Can I have a story?
lines.zh: 我不困。我可以讲故事吗？

lines.en: But maybe George is sleepy and doesn't want a story.
lines.zh: 但也许乔治很困，不想听故事。

lines.en: George, do you want a story? Say yes.
lines.zh: 乔治，你想要一个故事吗？说是的。

lines.en: Alright, I will tell you just one story.
lines.zh: 好吧，我只告诉你一个故事。

lines.en: If Daddy Pig tells you a story, you must both promise to go to sleep.
lines.zh: 如果猪爸爸给你讲故事，你们必须答应去睡觉。

lines.en: We promise.
lines.zh: 我们保证。

lines.en: Hmm, I think I'll tell you the story of The Sleepy Princess.
lines.zh: 嗯，我想我会告诉你《瞌睡公主》的故事。

lines.en: Is it a good story? It sounds a bit boring.
lines.zh: 这是一个好故事吗？听起来有点无聊。

lines.en: It's not boring. It's very good.
lines.zh: 这并不无聊。非常好。

lines.en: Is there a little princess in it?
lines.zh: 里面有小公主吗？

lines.en: Peppa, if you keep talking Daddy Pig can't start the story.
lines.zh: 佩奇，你再讲猪爸爸就没法开始故事了。

lines.en: Sorry Mummy. Is there a little princess in the story Daddy?
lines.zh: 对不起，妈妈。爸爸的故事里有小公主吗？

lines.en: Yes, there is a little princess in it.
lines.zh: 是的，里面有一个小公主。

lines.en: The Sleepy Princess
lines.zh: 瞌睡公主

lines.en: Once upon a time, in a castle, there lived a little princess.
lines.zh: 从前，在一座城堡里，住着一位小公主。

lines.en: And she was called The Sleepy Princess.
lines.zh: 她被称为“瞌睡公主”。

lines.en: Daddy, why was she called that?
lines.zh: 爸爸，为什么这么叫她？

lines.en: I'll get to that later.
lines.zh: 我稍后再讲。

lines.en: Was The Sleepy Princess pretty?
lines.zh: 瞌睡公主漂亮吗？

lines.en: Yes, she was very pretty. She loved looking at herself in the mirror.
lines.zh: 是的，她很漂亮。她喜欢照镜子。

lines.en: I am so pretty.
lines.zh: 我好漂亮。

lines.en: Who else was living at the castle?
lines.zh: 城堡里还有谁住？

lines.en: Well…
The others in the castle were The Small Prince, Queen Mummy and King Daddy.
lines.zh: 城堡里的其他人是小王子、王后妈妈和国王爸爸。

lines.en: That's right. They were all living there as well.
lines.zh: 没错。他们也都住在那里。

lines.en: Did King Daddy have a big tummy?
lines.zh: 爸爸大王肚子大吗？

lines.en: Of course not. He was very handsome. Like me.
lines.zh: 当然不是。他非常英俊。像我这样的。

lines.en: Anyway, there was also a dragon.
lines.zh: 总而言之，还有一条龙。

lines.en: Dinosaur!
lines.zh: 恐龙！

lines.en: A dinosaur? Oh yes, it wasn't a dragon. It was a dinosaur.
lines.zh: 恐龙？哦，是的，那不是龙。那是一只恐龙。

lines.en: Living outside was a huge, fierce dinosaur.
lines.zh: 外面生活着一只巨大而凶猛的恐龙。

lines.en: Roar!
lines.zh: 咆哮！

lines.en: Oh dear, maybe the dinosaur wasn't quite that fierce, Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 天哪，也许恐龙没那么凶猛，猪爸爸。

lines.en: Sorry, George. No, the dinosaur was very gentle. It ate lots of grass.
lines.zh: 对不起，乔治。不，恐龙非常温柔。它吃了很多草。

lines.en: Daddy Pig!
lines.zh: 猪爸爸！

lines.en: Sorry, I was being the dinosaur.
lines.zh: 抱歉，我是恐龙。

lines.en: Daddy, why is the princess called The Sleepy Princess?
lines.zh: 爸爸，为什么公主叫瞌睡公主呢？

lines.en: I'm coming to that.
lines.zh: 我正要讲这个。

lines.en: You see, the sun set, and the stars and moon came out, and everyone got very sleepy.
lines.zh: 你看，太阳落山了，星星月亮出来了，大家都困了。

lines.en: But the most sleepy of all was The Sleepy Princess.
lines.zh: 但最困的是《瞌睡公主》。

lines.en: Peppa, are you sleepy?
lines.zh: 佩奇，你困了吗？

lines.en: No, Daddy. I am not sleepy at all.
lines.zh: 不，爸爸。我一点也不困。

lines.en: But somebody is.
lines.zh: 但有人是。

lines.en: George, wake up! You'll miss the end of the story.
lines.zh: 乔治，醒醒！你会错过故事的结局。

lines.en: Well, Peppa might not be sleepy, but The Sleepy Princess certainly was.
lines.zh: 嗯，佩奇可能不困，但瞌睡公主肯定是。

lines.en: Looking at herself all day in the mirror had completely worn her out.
lines.zh: 整天对着镜子看自己，已经把她累坏了。

lines.en: Let's carry you to bed.
lines.zh: 让我们抱你去睡觉吧。

lines.en: Good night.
lines.zh: 晚安。

lines.en: The Sleepy Princess was so sleepy, she had fallen fast asleep.
lines.zh: 瞌睡公主太困了，她已经睡着了。

lines.en: Thank you for that story, King Daddy.
lines.zh: 谢谢你的故事，爸爸国王。

lines.en: You're welcome, Queen Mother.
lines.zh: 不客气，太后。

lines.en: And our little prince and princess enjoyed it, too.
lines.zh: 我们的小王子和小公主也很喜欢。
